description: AI systems can now provide detailed information about biological and chemical weapons development, including details about pathogens and expert-level laboratory instructions.

instances.assertion: AI models are increasingly capable of providing information that could assist in the creation of biological weapons.
AI models are increasingly using 'inference-time scaling' (using more compute during output generation) to improve reasoning performance.
AI models are increasingly capable of generating malicious code and performing cyberattacks.
AI systems can now provide detailed information about biological and chemical weapons development, including details about pathogens and expert-level laboratory instructions.
General-purpose AI systems can provide detailed information relevant to developing biological and chemical weapons, including instructions and troubleshooting.
AI models can provide actionable, step-by-step instructions for the creation of biological weapons, lowering the barrier to entry for malicious actors.
AI can assist in the creation and deployment of biological weapons.
